summary: End-to-end frontend testing of FlowDine iteration 2 (new pages: Features, About, Support, 4 Legal pages, Careers + updated Navbar/Footer). 78/79 functional checks passed; the 1 'fail' was a test-script artifact (inner_text snapshot), not an app issue — Problem/Solution/Outcome labels are confirmed present in source for all 6 detailed sections.

integration_issues.issue: Still uses placeholder access key 'YOUR_WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY'. Submit silently falls back to success toast — same intentional behavior carried over from iteration 1. MOCKED.
Form is local-only (setTimeout simulated submit, no API call). MOCKED — explicitly documented in review request.

action_items: (Optional, carry-over from iteration 1) Replace Web3Forms access key with real key when ready and remove silent success fallback so real failures surface.
(Optional) Support form is local-only — wire to a real backend or Web3Forms before launch, or document explicitly in product copy.
critical_code_review_comments: LegalPage.jsx correctly uses useLocation().pathname instead of useParams() — bug from this iteration is properly fixed; all 4 legal slugs render with correct titles + section counts (7/8/6/6).
Footer.jsx is clean: 3-column layout (Company/Product/Legal) renders all 11 links + footer-demo-btn correctly. Contact uses button (action) while others use Link.
Navbar.jsx correctly omits About from nav links array (per requirement) — About is footer-only. Mobile menu mirrors desktop with no About link.
SupportPage.jsx form validation correctly enforces name+phone+email; success state shown with 3.5s auto-reset. Issue Type Select (Radix) opens correctly and 5 options selectable with force=True.
FeaturesPage detailed sections (lines 140-170) include Problem/Solution/Outcome labels for all 6 features as required.
Code quality: All new pages follow existing design tokens (#08291f / #0e4839 / #f59e0b / #faf8f3). data-testid coverage is comprehensive across new pages.
(Minor) FeaturesPage.jsx is large (~470+ lines based on grep); consider extracting Detail component data into a separate constants file if it grows further.
